newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall on oversupply concerns.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall on oversupply concerns.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Thursday on reports that the government was releasing into the market higher free sale sugar stocks, dealers said.

"The free sale quota for the current month is 725,000 tonnes. The government has decided to free 800,000 tonnes for October, 850,000 tonnes for November and 800,000 tonnes for December delivery," one broker said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10/15 rupees to 1,320/1,360 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by the same margin at 1,360/1,410 rupees.
